en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style street scene showing a European city intersection with late‑19th‑century multi‑storey buildings. On the left is a corner building with the sign "H. Mehlhose" at street level and an obelisk-like monument in front, bordered by chains. On the right is another ornate corner building with a small tower; shop signs at the ground level include "Drogerie Germania" and a hotel or inn. Cobblestone streets, a few adults, a uniformed man, and several children in period clothing occupy the open square. A gas streetlamp stands on the right foreground.
